title: User Registration with Valid Data
description: Verify that a user can successfully register with valid email and password, then receive an email verification prompt.

steps.description: Navigate to the signup page
Input valid email address and strong password
Submit the signup form
Verify account is created and email verification message is shown

title: User Registration with Invalid Email
description: Validate that user registration fails with an invalid email format.

steps.description: Navigate to the signup page
Input invalid email format and a valid password
Submit the signup form
Verify validation error is displayed preventing signup

title: User Login with Correct Credentials
description: Check that a user can login successfully using a registered email and correct password.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Input a valid registered email and correct password
Submit the login form
Verify that user is authenticated and redirected to the dashboard

title: User Login Failure with Incorrect Password
description: Ensure login fails with appropriate error message when an incorrect password is provided.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Input registered email and incorrect password
Submit the login form
Verify error message is displayed indicating invalid credentials

title: Persistent User Session After Login
description: Verify that once logged in, user session persists and access is granted on page reloads and navigation, without re-authentication.

steps.description: Login with valid credentials
Reload the browser
Verify user remains logged in and dashboard is accessible
Navigate to resume builder and profile pages
Verify access is granted without additional login

title: Access Denied for Protected Routes without Authentication
description: Confirm that unauthenticated users are redirected to login page when attempting to access protected routes.

steps.description: Attempt to navigate directly to dashboard, resume builder, and profile pages without login
Verify user is redirected to the authentication page

title: Create New Resume with Complete Valid Data
description: Test creation of a new resume by filling all required multi-tab form fields with valid data, save, and verify real-time preview updates accordingly.

steps.description: Login and navigate to resume builder
Fill out personal info tab with valid data
Fill out summary, experience, education, and skills tabs with valid entries
Verify form validations pass on each tab
Switch between tabs and confirm data persists
Verify real-time resume preview updates dynamically with input changes
Save the resume
Verify resume is saved successfully and listed on dashboard

title: Form Validation for Required and Format Constraints
description: Verify validation errors appear when submitting incomplete or incorrectly formatted resume form data.

steps.description: Navigate to resume builder form
Leave required fields empty and input malformed data in email or date fields
Attempt to save or proceed to next tab
Check for appropriate validation error messages preventing progression

title: Edit Existing Resume and Verify Auto-Save
description: Confirm that when editing a saved resume, changes are auto-saved periodically and on tab switches without manual save.

steps.description: Log in and open an existing resume from dashboard
Modify multiple fields across different tabs
Verify changes appear instantly in resume preview
Switch tabs several times
Verify auto-save triggers and updates resume data on server without error

title: Resume CRUD Operations on Dashboard
description: Test creating, reading, updating, and deleting resumes via dashboard confirm proper UI feedback and data consistency.

steps.description: Login and navigate to dashboard
Create a new resume and verify it appears in the list
Select a listed resume and update its name or content
Verify updates persist and reflect in the list
Delete a resume from the dashboard
Verify resume is removed from the list and server database

title: Switch and Render Multiple Resume Templates
description: Verify that switching between different resume templates correctly updates the real-time preview and maintains user data.

steps.description: Open resume builder with saved resume data
Switch between various templates: Modern Blue, Minimal Classic, Creative Edge, etc.
Verify the preview updates to the selected template style without data loss

title: PDF Export with Style Preservation
description: Test exporting resumes to PDF ensuring the generated file preserves selected template styles, layout integrity and completes download successfully.

steps.description: Open a resume with populated fields and selected template
Trigger PDF export action
Verify exported PDF file downloads correctly
Open PDF and check preservation of template styles, fonts, colors, and layout correctness

title: User Profile Update and Avatar Management
description: Verify user can update profile information and upload/change avatar with proper validation and persistent storage.

steps.description: Login and navigate to profile page
Update personal information fields with valid data
Upload a new avatar image
Verify profile updates are saved and avatar displays as expected
Reload page and confirm persisted changes

title: Responsive UI Layout on Multiple Device Types
description: Verify the user interface renders correctly and remains fully functional on mobile, tablet, and desktop devices.

steps.description: Access app on desktop resolution viewport
Check layout is correct with no overlapping or broken elements
Access app on tablet resolution
Verify UI responsiveness and accessibility of all controls
Access app on mobile viewport
Verify mobile navigation, form usability, and preview are functional and readable

title: XSS and CSRF Security Enforcement
description: Test that input fields sanitize data properly to prevent Cross-Site Scripting attacks and that CSRF tokens protect authenticated requests.

steps.description: Input JavaScript or HTML injection strings into form fields
Submit the form and observe any script execution
Verify injected scripts are sanitized and not executed
Attempt unauthorized form submissions without CSRF token
Verify server rejects requests lacking valid CSRF protection

title: Error Handling for Unmatched Routes (404 Page)
description: Verify that navigating to an invalid URL shows the 404 Not Found page with correct messaging and navigation options.

steps.description: Manually input a non-existent route URL in the browser
Verify that the 404 error page is displayed
Check error page shows clear message and a link to navigate back to a valid page

title: Navigation Flow Maintains Authentication State
description: Verify that navigation between landing page, authentication pages, dashboard, builder, and profile respects authentication state without unexpected logouts.

steps.description: Log in to the application
Navigate through various internal pages: dashboard, resume builder, templates, profile
Verify user remains authenticated and access is granted without additional login prompts
Log out from user account
Verify protected routes are no longer accessible and user is redirected to authentication page
